Double-check wordle specifically for room to add more eligible player names before concluding it is maxed out. For every other game -- heatmap, connections, nba-grid, bingo, career-path, who-are-ya, tictactoe, contexto, fan-favorites, pack-five, superdraft, imposter, who-would-win -- there is real room to grow. Fan out one independent sub-agent per game so each generation run correctness-checks against just that game. Follow each existing generator/validator under backend/trivia/games/ or backend/trivia/questions/games/ (materialize/validate/build_pool already exist per game) rather than inventing a new format. Hard requirement: every generated question must be verifiably correct against the real curated players dataset -- no hallucinated stats, teams, seasons or facts; run each game existing validator against anything generated and reject/regenerate on failure. Prefer content variety (eras, teams, criteria types) over near-duplicates. There is no content-quality style guide yet for question generation -- if solid, reusable guidelines emerge, note them for a future task. Note: heatmap, connections, nba-grid, bingo, pack-five, superdraft and imposter are currently hidden from players in the live app (see hidden flag in src/utils/GameUtils.tsx) -- keep maintaining/expanding their data anyway, hidden is not deleted.
